SELECT schemaname, tablename, attname, n_distinct, correlation
                FROM pg_stats
                WHERE tablename IN ('users', 'orders', 'order_items')
                ORDER BY tablename, attname;
                SELECT indexname, tablename, indexdef
                FROM pg_indexes
                WHERE schemaname = 'public'
                AND tablename IN ('users', 'orders', 'order_items');
                SELECT relname, n_tup_ins, n_tup_upd, n_tup_del, n_live_tup, n_dead_tup
                FROM pg_stat_user_tables
                WHERE relname IN ('users', 'orders', 'order_items');
f2785c93213b72877870968ff27faebf.rewritten_query:
SELECT 
  ps.schemaname, 
  ps.tablename, 
  ps.attname, 
  ps.n_distinct, 
  ps.correlation,
  pi.indexname,
  pi.indexdef,
  pst.n_tup_ins,
  pst.n_tup_upd,
  pst.n_tup_del,
  pst.n_live_tup,
  pst.n_dead_tup
FROM pg_stats ps
LEFT JOIN pg_indexes pi ON ps.tablename = pi.tablename AND ps.schemaname = pi.schemaname
LEFT JOIN pg_stat_user_tables pst ON ps.tablename = pst.relname
WHERE ps.schemaname = 'public' 
  AND ps.tablename IN ('users', 'orders', 'order_items')
ORDER BY ps.tablename, ps.attname;
